en.hook: High write amplification and 4-second query latencies ruin real-time dashboards.
en.body:
High write amplification and 4-second query latencies ruin real-time dashboards. Master ClickHouse MergeTree primary key index tuning to restore sub-second SLOs.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.

pt.body:
